launch.label: from first call to subscription payment

steps.title: 4 steps from first contact to revenue

items.title: Introduce the client to the platform
items.description: You share a referral link with the client and help them register. This starts the project and records your partner channel.

items.title: Launch the first AI employee shift
items.description: Within 5 business days the team prepares a demo and configures an AI employee for the client's tasks. The client sees the first working scenario and evaluates the result in practice.

items.title: Align on commercial terms
items.description: After the demo and first result, the client confirms the launch. You define subscription pricing and your service format independently.

items.title: Pay for subscriptions via your partner account
items.description: You top up your partner balance and pay for the client's subscription with your discount, while also earning a percentage from account top-ups.

items.title: An in-demand AI product
items.description: Clients don't need abstract innovation explained — they see concrete tasks that can be automated right now.

items.title: Clear partner economics
items.description: Your revenue sources are clear upfront: implementation, a partner discount on client subscriptions, and a percentage from top-ups.

items.title: Fast go-live
items.description: The solution deploys without a long development cycle, which speeds up first revenue and reduces team load.

items.title: Your level grows with volume
items.description: The more subscription payments go through your partner account, the higher your level and the better your terms.

levels.title: Three partner program levels
levels.subtitle: Three participation levels with different subscription discounts and referral payouts.

items.name: Level 2
items.condition: After 50,000,000 UZS of subscription payments from your partner account over the last 365 days

items.name: Level 1
items.condition: After 150,000,000 UZS of subscription payments from your partner account over the last 365 days
